$comment: l10n parity ratchet (tests/l10n/check-l10n-parity.js --ratchet). Strict locales list every English key they lack; other locales record how many English keys they translate. Rewrite with: node tests/l10n/check-l10n-parity.js --update

nl: Append-only log of the school's follow-up handling for this incident (a check-in the next day, a referral to a doctor, a return-to-play decision). Each addition MUST be a new audited version of the appendOnly incident (ADR-008) — never an in-place edit of a prior entry. Same shape as BehaviourIncident.followUpActions.
Call order; 1 is called first. Null entries sort last.

Date a guardian last confirmed medicalConditions/allergies as accurate. School policy expects this refreshed yearly (finding G-new-12); no automatic expiry or reminder is built by this change — a stale date is a visual signal for staff to re-ask, not an enforced gate.

Emergency contacts to reach when no guardian in guardianRefs is reachable, e.g. a grandparent or neighbour with no Learniq identity of their own (finding G-new-12). Ordered by priority; the first entry is called first.
Free-text allergies relevant to the school's duty of care (finding G-new-12).
Free-text description of the first aid or treatment given, if any. Null when the incident is recorded but no treatment was administered.
Free-text description of the follow-up action taken.
Free-text medical conditions relevant to the school's duty of care (finding G-new-12), distinct from a FirstAidIncident, which records a single dated event rather than a standing condition.
Free-text relationship to the learner, e.g. 'grandparent' or 'neighbour'.
Full name of the emergency contact.
Home address (finding 2.1/G-new-12). Free-form Dutch address fields; no postcode-API lookup or validation is performed.
How the incident was resolved. Set on the resolve transition. Null until resolved.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Defaults to 'NL'.
ISO 8601 timestamp the guardian was notified. Null until notifiedGuardian is set true.
ISO 8601 timestamp when this follow-up action was recorded.

Learner's current age in whole years, calculated from birthDate (finding 2.11). Null when birthDate is unset. Recalculated on read/write per OpenRegister's computed-fields materialisation, so it never goes stale the way a manually-set flag would the day after a birthday.
Nextcloud user ID of the learner this first-aid incident concerns.
Nextcloud user ID of the staff member who administered first aid / reported this incident.
Nextcloud user ID of the staff member who recorded this follow-up action.
Phone number to reach this contact on.
Similarity score in [0.0, 1.0] as returned by ProvidesPlagiarismCheck::getSimilarityScore(). Null until plagiarismStatus is 'completed'.

Status of a plagiarism check for this submission (finding 6.11). Set to 'pending' when a provider check is submitted (OCA\Learniq\Plagiarism\ProvidesPlagiarismCheck::submitForCheck()), 'completed' once a score is available. No built-in provider ships with learniq — this is the data-model landing spot only.
Street name, without the house number.

The Dutch statutory referentieniveau achieved on this attempt (finding 6.8). Tracking per pupil over time is satisfied by querying a learner's AssessmentResult history — no separate mechanism is needed.
The method's block/unit this mark covers (e.g. 'blok 3'), set when sourceKind=method-test. Null for every other sourceKind.
The teaching method this mark came from (e.g. 'Wereld in Getallen', 'Snappet'), set when sourceKind=method-test (finding 6.6). Null for every other sourceKind.
Timestamp the plagiarism check completed. Null until plagiarismStatus is 'completed'.

True once the learner has reached 12 years old (finding 2.11) — the age Dutch AVG practice treats as the start of a minor's own co-decision rights over their data. Null when birthDate/ageYears is unset. Data-model only: no portal action reads this yet (a separate, code-kind change's responsibility).

True once the learner has reached 16 years old (finding 2.11) — the age this finding's competitor evidence (osiris: "Vanaf 18 jaar..."; progress: majority-based) treats as full self-service autonomy in this domain. Null when birthDate/ageYears is unset. Data-model only: no portal action reads this yet.
Whether a guardian was notified of this incident.

Whether this is an ordinary teaching cohort, or a standing care/plusklas subgroup (finding 1.14) — a group that persists across periods rather than living inside a single GroupPlan's ephemeral instructieniveau subgroups (GroupPlanSubgroup). 'care' covers e.g. a remedial or sublesgroep; 'plusklas' covers gifted-education pull-out groups.

Whether this profile holds legal parental authority (gezag) over the child/children it is linked to as a guardian. Meaningful only on a profile carrying the 'parent' role (G-new-12/finding 2.4); null/unset on a learner's own profile. A single flag per guardian profile — it does not yet vary per linked child, a documented limitation for blended-family cases where gezag differs child by child.
Which statutory concern this flag represents (finding 4.9). SWV notification, where applicable, reuses the existing dataExchangeJobId field rather than a new one.
